description: Start the device-code login. Returns a URL and a code; the browser opens automatically unless open_browser is false. The server keeps polling in the background: call whoami to confirm, or set wait_seconds to block until linked.

open_browser.description: Open the verification URL in the default browser. Default true.

wait_seconds.description: Block up to this many seconds for the link to complete. Default 0 (return at once).

name: login
title: Connect to Textile Designer AI
